title: Zephyrine and the Orbit
author: Ivo Galloway
blurb: Ivo Lockridge, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
